rationale: The outline is the h1 followed directly by this h4 in main content, with no h2 or h3 between them, so levels are skipped.
The extra text is display:none, so it is hidden from screen readers too; the name is just "Read more" with no context giving the destination.
visibility:hidden removes "about rugby" from the accessible name; "Read more" alone does not say where the link goes.
The question "Which types of waste do you transport regularly?" is only a visual h4, not tied to the checkboxes by a fieldset/legend, and it gives the options their meaning (transported regularly).
Exact pixel measurement shows about 19.6:1 everywhere under the glyphs, with no background below 4.5:1.

The box holds text deliberately requiring horizontal scrolling to read ("text you have to horizontally scroll to read") and nothing in it is focusable, so keyboard users in some browsers cannot scroll it.
The empty th is the top-left corner cell above the row headers (Jackie, Beth); no data column loses its header.
It is a data table (names, ages, birthdays) whose header row uses td cells, so the data cells have no programmatic headers.
This is the site name link in the footer, a name rather than a section title for following content.
The mouseover/mouseout handlers on the carousel pause and resume auto-rotation on hover, which is a convenience; keyboard users have the play/pause button and focus-based pausing.
"Example" names the section that holds the live example of the carousel, which is its real purpose on this documentation page, not a template leftover.
